pages.text: The components of the parasitic battlemage's craft. Most are now made only on the dais. The $(item)Golden Book$() can still be bound at a table, but the altar makes it without a nether star.$(br2)$(item)Abomination crystals$() come out two at a time: a plain magic crystal in the centre, Abomination dust on the four sides, the corners left empty.
